refs.note: Designer link prop typed as a URL path (/rooms). Where the page exists on the site, link to the page itself, not a typed slash path. Global.
Split image text light: too much functionality and too many visibility settings in one component. Break it up. Panel shows typed /history URL too (see H1).
Image Trio Text: borderline, too much functionality (paragraph visible, CTA visible, items header and text). CTA link typed as /wellness instead of the page (see H1).
Venue Card Fullbleed Tall: too many toggles. Show Image makes no sense; Show Intro does nothing when toggled.
Map Feature: is title, description, button and image, but carries a long list of place name, walk and link props. Simplify.
faq-accordion has no properties and static questions. Should be driven by a CMS collection.
History timeline image (1924) is image only; should also accept a video. Aspect ratio must hold for both.

Gallery Mosaic Captioned uses fixed Image 1-4 props and Show Figure toggles. Should use a component slot: two items sit side by side, a third becomes the big image below; grows and shrinks with item count. Applies on every page that uses it.
More of the Guild (Card Carousel Header Left) uses fixed Card 1-4 props (label, link, image, show image). Should use a component slot. Links typed as /wellness, /meetings (see H1).
timeline-scatter-images exposes only Caption 1-4 props; the images themselves cannot be changed from the component.
Blog has one hand-built section and Collection List per category (dining, culture, conferences). A new category would need Designer work. Should be one list grouped by category, like /press.

Today built from separate paragraph and heading elements. The look (large title left, caps section headings with space above and below, body text, bullet lists) is the target; the build underneath must become one rich text element. Ignore the element selection outlines.
timeline-scatter-images (Tall variant, Beyond Downtown San Diego) exposes only Caption 1-4; images not editable. Same component as G1.
Corporate & Services section is a plain section (section_neighborhood-corporate), not a component; card count fixed. Should be a component whose cards sit in a slot.
Article Card Staggered Tall (Dining Around the Guild) uses fixed Card 1-n props with Show Image toggles. Cards should sit in a slot so the count can grow or shrink.
Empty Div with id request-for-proposal below the venue cards. It is the jump target for a #request-for-proposal link on the page; an empty element should not carry it.
Key Features of Our Spaces (meetings-collection-features_component) is a plain div, not a component; its list items are fixed.

Venue cards (Council Boardroom, Lobby Terrace, One America Plaza) and their Overlay Detail Panel Modals are hand-built static instances, each button wired by a typed data-modal-open id. Should come from a CMS collection.
Privacy Policy built from separate paragraphs on the same static-template layout as L1. The look is the target; the body must become one rich text element. Ignore selection outlines.
Retail (Shops at the Guild) Offers Slider Split: slides are fixed Slide 1-5 props with Show slide and Show image toggles. Should come from a CMS collection.
Offers & Packages Offers Slider Split: same fixed Slide 1-5 props, repeated on about 15 pages. Should come from a CMS collection so every page shows the same offers.

Dining CMS item has Split navy / Split olive switches and a Show card switch per venue for Other dining options. Other dining options should list every other venue automatically, excluding the current one.
Dining template: Split image text light shows placeholder props (Eyebrow, lorem body, Body 2, CTA #) not bound to the CMS item. Most of the template is not connected to the CMS.
Other dining label 1-3 fields are multi-line text for one-line values. Single values must be single-line fields; these label fields should not exist at all.
Gallery Mosaic Captioned on the Dining template: heading bound to a CMS field, but images are fixed Image 1-n props, so each venue cannot have its own number of photos or videos.
Explore the Space (Split image text light, Stagger Left): the heading is the same on every venue, so it needs no CMS field. Placeholder props (Eyebrow, Body 2, CTA #, lorem caption) also visible.
Context only: Key Features (Image Trio Text Left) on the Legal & Corporate template. Whether it is per item or shared across Legal and Corporate is an open question for Omar; not built in this spec.

Room Description: numbered detail rows (bed, guests, size, more lines) are hand-built static elements, not CMS. Keep the look (superscript numbers, divider lines); content must come from the room's CMS item.
In Room Amenities: 4-column grid of amenity names with dividers, hand-built and static. Keep the look; content must come from the CMS.
Room gallery (Gallery Mosaic Captioned) uses fixed Image 1-n props; must grow and shrink per room.
Discover Other Rooms (Card Carousel Header Left) uses fixed Card props with typed /rooms/cozy-king links. Should list other rooms from the Rooms collection, excluding the current room.
Context only: The Neighborhood map on room pages stays the same on every room; no CMS field needed.

Booking Menu, Reserve a table pop-up (Overlay Detail Panel Modal, Image Bg, id book-table): carries leftover content props from other uses (heading council boardroom, eyebrow by eva struble, artwork caption) and 60 suggested props. Its content should come from the Dinings collection.
Same pop-up: Media, Body and Extras props with show toggles and lorem text, none of which should be hand-filled here.
Arts filter tabs (All, Painting, Photography, Sculpture) are hand-built links with typed data-gallery-filter-tag values. Should be built from a CMS categories collection.
Gallery filter tabs (All, Design, Wellness, Dining, Rooms, Amenities, Guests) are hand-built links. Should be built from a CMS categories collection.
